Building index · FY2027 roll

Buildings over the $1 million line

661 condominiums and 396 co-ops on the FY2027 roll.

People search for a pied-à-terre tax list. These pages are not a list of owners who pay. They answer a building-level question: how many apartments in a building have a city market value at or above the $1 million line for the surcharge, and how the city reached that value. They do not show owners, apartment numbers or who pays.

Inclusion threshold and other property types

Condos are listed when at least 5 units are valued at $1 million or more. Co-ops are listed when the building value averages $1 million or more per apartment; in other co-ops, apartments with a large share of the stock can still cross the line. Queens (5 condo units across small buildings), the Bronx (1 unit), and Staten Island (0 units) have no individual condo or co-op buildings meeting the 5-unit listing rule on the FY2027 roll.
